does: Implements range sets (922 lines): RangeValue and Range (:3-56), the immutable layered and chunked RangeSet with update, map, between, iter, compare, eq, spans, of, join and empty (:222-482), RangeSetBuilder (:484-568), and the private machinery behind them: Chunk with binary search and per-range mapping (:102-179), LayerCursor over one layer, HeapCursor merging layers through a binary heap (:584-739), SpanCursor tracking active ranges and points for span iteration and comparison (:741-866), and the compare/sameValues helpers (:868-922). Ranges are kept sorted by from and startSide in chunks of at most 250, overlapping ranges move to lower layers, and maxPoint lets point-only scans skip chunks and layers.
platform: TypeScript type system: `declare` fields, `private`/`@internal` members, structural interfaces (RangeCursor, RangeComparator, SpanIterator) and a variance-workaround type parameter on update (:267-271). JS runtime: prototype-level field defaults (:34-36), object identity for emptiness (:356), set and chunk matching (:394-395, :570-582) and value equality (:11, :39); a cyclic singleton patched with `as any` (:467, :482); `null` assigned to invalidate a finished builder (:565); the 1e9 fixnum sentinel (:98-99); `Array.prototype.sort` stability (:275, :475). No DOM, CSS, browser or Lezer use.
